title: Slow learner
desc: Doesn't catch on to new concepts very quickly.

title: Foodie
desc: Lives to cook, and eats more than their share.

title: Wimp
desc: <name> can't handle much more than a papercut.

title: Precise
desc: Works at a slower pace, but produces higher quality work.

title: Sloppy
desc: Works at a faster pace, but produces lower quality work.

title: Storyteller
desc: <name> loves using their imagination, but doesn't like doing much else.

title: Hard worker
desc: <name> has a strong work ethic. They will work faster than average.

title: Lazy
desc: <name> can never be bothered to do more than the bare minimum. They will slack off and work slower than average.

title: Night Owl
desc: <name> prefers the cover of night. They are unaffected by the penalties of darkness, and actually rejoice in it.

title: Pyromaniac
desc: Later, fires lift the mood, a cold camp drags it down, and a break may start a fire.

title: Man-eater
desc: Human flesh is a favorite meal of <name>'s. After trying it once, they just couldn't get enough of it.

title: Austere
desc: <name> loves to sleep under the stars. As long as they have a soft bed, they're fine with resting just about anywhere.

title: Murderous
desc: Ending someone's life gives <name> a rush of adrenaline. They are dependent on the euphoric high of violence, and will get antsy after a few days without spilling blood.

title: Psychopath
desc: <name> has no concept of morality or empathy. Other people are nothing more than pawns to be used and discarded.

title: Quick sleeper
desc: <name> doesn't need to sleep very long. They can get by on just a few hours of sleep.
